paper.title: Evolution in Simulation: AI-Agent School with Dual Memory for High-Fidelity Educational Dynamics
paper.central_claim: Zero-Exp通过经验/知识双库与短长期层级驱动持续经验-反思-优化，使多角色智能体自主进化并高保真模拟真实教育互动。

provenance.notes: Opus aggregate seat via the configured claude-kimi type fable; no route probing. actual_model/session_id/receipt_ref are null because the subagent runtime exposes no verifiable provider receipt to this worker.

sections_read: Opus: complete pinned text read end-to-end (abstract, all sections, tables, appendices) before opening seat records; targeted re-reads for every disputed field

evidence.quote: first, there is a lack of systematic modeling of the teaching process, and second, LLM agents struggle to accurately simulate the behaviors and interactions of diverse participants in educational settings.
evidence.support_explanation: 作者提出教育模拟系统性与角色保真问题；不是完整最近邻排除。

evidence.quote: this study will build upon the logic of the AI agent town and Agent Hospital
evidence.support_explanation: 明确 Generative Agents/Agent Hospital 谱系，但未固定邻居原文做独立比较。

evidence.quote: The contents of both the experience and knowledge bases are stored and managed within a vector database.
evidence.support_explanation: 留存对象是非权重外部经验/知识库。

evidence.quote: The retrieved memories are then integrated into the final user prompt.
evidence.support_explanation: 先检索短期再长期记忆，后续动作实际通过提示词读取。

evidence.quote: New insights, facts, or optimized strategies derived from the interaction or internal reasoning are added to the Knowledge Memory Base.
evidence.support_explanation: 运行交互之后将策略与知识写回。

evidence.quote: Also, identify any existing entries in your Long-term Memory Bases that should be updated, corrected, or reinforced based on this new information.
evidence.support_explanation: 对既存条目提供更正/强化，但无明确效用门控、版本与回退。

evidence.quote: Finally, this generated data underwent rigorous expert modification, reorganization, and reordering by educational experts to produce the complete and final interaction dataset, serving as the ground truth for evaluation and iteration.
evidence.support_explanation: 参考由生成后专家修订；同一流同时用于评估和迭代。

evidence.quote: We conducted simulations for each of these nine configurations using the standard group dataset described in Section
evidence.support_explanation: 九配置是同源数据上的结构/存储消融，不是独立留出证明。

evidence.quote: we compared the agent’s generated response to a reference ground truth answer using the average ROUGE-L
evidence.support_explanation: ROUGE-L 是文本重合代理，不直接验证真实学校因果/行为分布。

evidence.quote: For each question, the experts were presented with the four corresponding answers in a blind, randomized order.
evidence.support_explanation: 9专家盲评：每组500 QA/10时点/50角色，支持感知真实度而非现实外部有效性。
完整结构GPT-4o终点0.53；同表ID9终点0.25、ID4 0.39。
后段full偏好42–46%；标准组44–48%。相近偏好并非统计等价证明。

evidence.quote: the fidelity of the simulation is also dependent on the quality and diversity of the initial expert-curated dataset used for evaluation and guiding the initial evolution.
evidence.support_explanation: 作者承认参考数据同时引导演化、规模仅50角色5天，不能支持独立留存迁移。

evidence.quote: If no significant updates are deemed necessary based on the recent reflections, state that the role setting remains largely unchanged.
evidence.support_explanation: 角色设置更新有no-op选项，但没有效果验证接受规则。

evidence.quote: AAS constructs the Zero-Exp strategy, employs a continuous "experience-reflection-optimization" cycle, grounded in a dual memory base comprising experience and knowledge bases and incorporating short-term and long-term memory components.
evidence.support_explanation: Central mechanism: dual (experience/knowledge) x (ST/LT) memory with a reflection cycle.

evidence.quote: first, there is a lack of systematic modeling of the teaching process, and second, LLM agents struggle to accurately simulate the behaviors and interactions of diverse participants in educational settings.
evidence.support_explanation: Author-stated gap: domain simulation fidelity, not a fixed non-weight harness component.

evidence.quote: In light of this, this study will build upon the logic of the AI agent town and Agent Hospital
evidence.support_explanation: Closest neighbors named: Generative Agents and Agent Hospital; no head-to-head comparison.

evidence.quote: The contents of both the experience and knowledge bases are stored and managed within a vector database.
evidence.support_explanation: Persistence substrate: vector DB, cosine-similarity retrieval.

evidence.quote: the retrieval process of the Zero-Exp mechanism is designed to prioritize accessing relevant information from the agent's short-term memory.
evidence.support_explanation: Retrieval order ST then LT.

evidence.quote: New insights, facts, or optimized strategies derived from the interaction or internal reasoning are added to the Knowledge Memory Base.
evidence.support_explanation: Write path: LLM-derived insights appended to the knowledge base; no external admission test stated.

evidence.quote: Agent's reflection or changes in understanding resulting from the interaction and memory updates are also used to dynamically update aspects of their internal Role Setting (e.g., teaching methods, study habits).
evidence.support_explanation: Second retained object: the role-setting prompt is rewritten from reflection.

evidence.quote: Finally, this generated data underwent rigorous expert modification, reorganization, and reordering by educational experts to produce the complete and final interaction dataset, serving as the ground truth for evaluation and iteration.
evidence.support_explanation: Single curated 5-day dataset is both reference and iteration driver; role of reference in the loop is not specified.

evidence.quote: For automated evaluation, we compared the agent's generated response to a reference ground truth answer using the average ROUGE-L
evidence.support_explanation: Primary metric is ROUGE-L overlap with curated text.

evidence.quote: We recruited nine educational experts to evaluate these QA pairs.
evidence.support_explanation: Blind expert preference vote over 4 groups, 50 QA per checkpoint.

evidence.quote: The full model (ID 1), incorporating both the dual KB/EB structure and the ST/LT hierarchy, achieves the highest ROUGE-L scores, reaching peaks around 0.51-0.55 in the later stages.
evidence.support_explanation: Headline ROUGE-L result.

evidence.quote: Comparing ID 9 with any configuration using an external memory base (IDs 1-8) shows a substantial performance gap, demonstrating the fundamental benefit of external memory.
evidence.support_explanation: Store-off (context-only, ID 9) control exists.

evidence.quote: Notably, the full model's perceived realism approaches and stabilizes near that of the standard group (ID 0) in the later stages (from 60%).
evidence.support_explanation: Human blind vote: memory agent approaches expert reference.

evidence.quote: evaluation is performed periodically during the iterative process.
evidence.support_explanation: Evaluation interleaved with memory accumulation on the same stream (prequential).

evidence.quote: Firstly, the current simulation scale is relatively limited, involving only 50 agents (10 teachers and 40 students) over a 5-day period.
evidence.support_explanation: Scale limit; single dataset.

evidence.quote: the fidelity of the simulation is also dependent on the quality and diversity of the initial expert-curated dataset used for evaluation and guiding the initial evolution.
evidence.support_explanation: Authors concede the curated dataset guides evolution as well as evaluation.

evidence.quote: ID 1 consistently outperforms ID 2.
evidence.support_explanation: Dual-vs-unified claim; Table 3 (Qwen3-235B) shows ID2 >= ID1 at 10-15% checkpoints, so 'consistently' is overstated.

evidence.quote: serving as the ground truth for evaluation and iteration
evidence.support_explanation: The same expert-edited stream both drives the simulation ('iteration') and is the scoring reference.

evidence.quote: Subsequently, the Gemini-2.5-Pro model generated an initial 5-day sequence of agent actions and interactions
evidence.support_explanation: The reference is LLM-generated then expert-edited, not observed school behaviour (only classroom teaching actions come from real classrooms).

evidence.quote: reflecting fluency and content overlap
evidence.support_explanation: The authors themselves describe ROUGE-L as lexical overlap/fluency, not behavioural fidelity.

evidence.quote: the experts were asked to vote for the answer they believed best reflected a realistic response in the given educational context
evidence.support_explanation: Forced single-choice vote among four answers; the vote-aggregation rule across nine experts and inter-rater agreement are not reported.

evidence.quote: However, some scholars have pointed out the limitations of current agents in the education field
evidence.support_explanation: The motivating limitation is asserted without a citation.

evidence.quote: Comprises the entirety of the respective Experience Base or Knowledge Base.
evidence.support_explanation: Long-term memory is unbounded: no capacity, forgetting or consolidation rule.

evidence.quote: Based on the agent’s autonomous selection, selected new memories are also added to the agent’s Short-term Memory
evidence.support_explanation: Short-term admission is the model's own choice; no external write gate.
Context-only (no external memory) also rises 0.10→0.25 over the stream, so part of the rise is accumulating stream context, not memory evolution.
Unified memory (ID 2) is ≥ full model (ID 1: 0.07 0.14 0.17 0.2 0.29 0.28 …) for most of the first 30% of the stream.

evidence.quote: ID 1 consistently outperforms ID 2
evidence.support_explanation: The 'consistently' claim is contradicted early in the stream (opus:O09).

G.reason: Opus sides with son55. The motivating limitation is asserted without a source (opus:O05) and the closest neighbours (Generative Agents memory stream + reflection, Agent Hospital experience base) are adopted as the template (sol:E002) rather than contrasted: no residual is stated for what a dual/tiered store adds over their memory and reflection mechanisms. A domain application gap, not a located fixed-component gap; above 0 because the target (role-consistent multi-agent school simulation) is concrete.

M.reason: Both seats 2; re-checked. 双库/分层、反思写回、提示词使用能回应角色持续性；语义相似和自评筛选为何提升真实行为仍是弱假设。

X.reason: Opus sides with sol. Write/read path is reconstructable from §3.2 and the Appendix B/C prompts (retrieve ST then LT, write LT experience/knowledge, agent-selected ST, role-setting rewrite). Missing: external write gate (opus:O07), capacity/forgetting (LT is 'the entirety', opus:O06), conflict handling, versioning/rollback, and which agent actions (generated or reference) enter memory. That is the anchor-2 description 'main steps described, retention/recovery or key conditions unclear'; nothing is contradictory or missing at the operation level, so not 1. The information-permission gap is scored once, under E.holdout (A2).

E.measurement.reason: Opus sides with son55. The central claim is fidelity to real educational dynamics, but both instruments are anchored to an LLM-generated, expert-edited stream (opus:O02). The automated metric is lexical overlap by the authors' own description (opus:O03), which a memory that stores reference-stream text can raise without behavioural fidelity. The blind expert vote is the stronger instrument but is forced-choice, GPT-4o only, three of nine configurations, and reports no aggregation rule or agreement (opus:O04). Above 0 because the blinded expert design measures perceived realism directly.

E.causality.reason: Both seats 2; re-checked (9-config grid × 3 backbones incl. store-off; role-setting update not ablated; ID1>ID2 not consistent early, opus:O09; context-only also rises, opus:O08). 九配置在三基座上消融库和层级，包含store-off；未匹配检索/生成预算，角色更新和记忆更新亦未独立隔离。

E.holdout.reason: Both seats 1; re-checked (same stream for iteration and scoring, opus:O01). Only temporal prequential structure on one 5-day stream; no held-out scenario/population, no leakage audit of whether reference actions enter memory (A2: ground-truth-in-loop risk).

E.statistics.reason: Both seats 1; re-checked (A2 ladder: denominators, no uncertainty). 明确50角色、每组500 QA与9专家且报告较弱基线；无运行方差/区间/检验，按A2为1。

E.cost.reason: Both seats not_reported; re-checked. 适用的完整推断/记忆维护预算与相同预算对照未报告；非缺材料。

reason: Complete pinned v1 text incl. Appendices A–D read; in scope (system_method): a non-weight memory written during the simulation and read on later steps. All eight items resolved.

resolutions.reason: Uncited motivating limitation (opus:O05); nearest neighbours adopted, not contrasted (sol:E002). sol's own reason ('neighbours only narrated; residual not checked') describes the anchor-1 situation.

Main write/read steps reconstructable with prompts; missing gate/forgetting/rollback = anchor-2 wording. son55's ground-truth-in-loop point is real but belongs to E.holdout (A2: one defect, one item).
Synthetic reference + lexical metric + under-reported forced-choice vote for a real-world fidelity claim.

C03's skip-upstream branch (retrieved reference instances as prompt input) is executed, matching the run convention for retrieval memories (r07a ArcMemo, partial fit). The store partition is the paper's ablated design claim, so heterogeneous_decomposition is a fair supporting card (low fit).

Same question in both seats (does fidelity hold beyond the one curated stream). Nothing outside the stream is tested and the stream drives iteration (opus:O01); 'partial' credited same-stream fit, which is not what the expectation asks.

Both seats ask whether the 'significant' claims are statistically backed. Full text read, so 'unknown' (son55) is not the right state; denominators alone (sol 'partial') do not back a significance claim.
Verified: no call/token/time/memory-growth cost anywhere; son55 recorded the same fact as E.cost not_reported.
Verified: ID 9 isolates external memory; no alternative conditioning at matched budget.
Verified: no audit of whether reference-stream content enters memory; applies because fidelity to later behaviour is claimed (opus:O01).
Verified: unified/LT-only/context-only variants; no reflection-memory or literature baseline.
Verified: memory modules ablated; the role-setting rewrite (App. C) is never ablated.
Verified: one simulated school, one 5-day stream; authors list scale as a limitation.

App. B asks the agent to update/correct/reinforce existing LT entries (localized edits exist), but there is no consolidation, forgetting or bound (opus:O06). son55 recorded S4 'unmet' only as an H01 condition check; the update instruction makes 'partial' the supported state.
Verified: the store is built on the evaluated stream (opus:O01); sol recorded the same fact under local-1.
Same fact as S2 (sol): model outputs enter memory on the agent's own selection (opus:O07).
Same fact as F4 (son55), which also lists 'S2 unmet' in its H04 condition checks.

Expected low G and measurement, E.holdout 1, cost not reported.
